body_text:
Cancellation laws. In a group, $ax=ay$ implies $x=y$ and $xa=ya$
implies $x=y$. Consequently the equations $ax=b$ and $ya=b$ have
the unique solutions $x=a^{-1}b$ and $y=ba^{-1}$. The order of the
factors matters in a nonabelian group.
